title: Khadas VIM1S / VIM3 / VIM4
notes: Dimensions from Khadas' official 3D model of the VIM1S (vim1s-pcba-3d-v11.stp). The official 3D models and 2D drawings of the VIM3 and VIM4 have the same outline and holes.
s = 0 is the GPIO-header edge, which faces the back plate. The holes are a trapezoid (77 / 49 / 45.5 mm).
The opening that runs out past s = S is the microSD notch, in the middle of the port-side edge (the slot is under the board).
Standoffs 5 mm tall because the LAN jack sticks out 3.5 mm below the board.
